//: O2C Timesheet Module — VBCS backend catalogue.
TWO backends:
oc_time   the module's own ORDS surface over its ATP schema. Everything
transactional goes here, and every business rule lives behind
it in OC_TIME_PKG.
fa        Oracle Fusion, added 01-Aug-2026 alongside the Oracle Cloud
Applications backend configured in VB Studio.
An earlier version of this file said Fusion must never be declared here
because it would put OAuth credentials in the client. That was wrong. A VB
backend is a SERVER-SIDE PROXY: the runtime attaches the credentials and
forwards the call, so nothing secret reaches the browser. NFR-005 is about
secrets in the client and this puts none there.
What the proxy does not settle is where the data then lives — see the note
on the fa backend below.
Replace the urls per environment; never commit a PROD url (Instructions
sheet: 'Keep values environment-neutral').
VB Studio owns the fa section. If Designer rewrites it, keep Designer's
version — these comments are the only part worth carrying forward.
Oracle Fusion, reached through VB's server-side proxy.
NOTE ON USE. The module is built so master data lands in the OC_TIME_*
cache tables and every page reads it back through ORDS — which is what
lets OC_TIME_PKG enforce the rules over all of it. Data a page fetches
straight from Fusion does not pass through that, so no rule sees it.
Calling Fusion live was chosen deliberately (01-Aug-2026). For a lookup
the cache cannot answer that is sound. For anything a rule must later
validate, the value has to be written back through ORDS or the rule is
simply bypassed.
PROJECT SETUP -- READ THIS AFTER ANY WORKSPACE OR PROJECT REBUILD.
The VB Studio project's own Backends configuration REPLACES this block at
runtime, children and all. It is not in source control, it does not survive
a project move, and nothing warns you when it is missing. Three rebuilds,
three outages, same cause.
Set Services -> Backends -> fa to the pod host PLUS the HCM REST prefix:
https://fa-etao-dev20-saasfademo1.ds-fa.oraclepdemos.com/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05
That is what the V2 project resolves to and what fa_hcm/openapi3.json is
written against -- its paths start at the resource name (/workers,
/absences) and must NOT repeat the prefix.
The hcm and scm children below are the cleaner design and are what this
file declares, but they only apply when NO project override exists. Do not
switch fa_hcm back to vb-catalog://backends/fa/hcm on the strength of them:
with an override in place VB cannot see the child and appends the literal
segment /hcm instead, which 404s.
Judge it by the URL Preview on getWorkers, never by this file. Correct is
{pod}/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/workers -- prefix exactly once.
